Column 1 is twice column 0, so reuse its sum.
```cpp
// Baseline: port of operators::table_mult (benchmarks/extract_embedding_ckks). Generated by llm_loop/gen_baselines.py.
void fhe()
{
  Ciphertext indicator("indicator");
  vector<Plaintext> columns;
  for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
    columns.emplace_back("table_" + to_string(i));
  vector<Ciphertext> sums;
  for (const Plaintext &column : columns)
  {
    // reduce_add: rotate-and-sum over all slots, log2(slots) rotations.
    Ciphertext sum = indicator * column;
    for (size_t step = slots() / 2; step > 0; step /= 2)
      sum += sum << static_cast<int>(step);
    sums.push_back(sum);
  }
  sums[0].set_output("output_0");
  (sums[0] + sums[0]).set_output("output_1");
  sums[2].set_output("output_2");
}
```
